author: benhur

Hey Amit. Nice catch.

Just my two cents: I think your SL is at risk to be taken as it is located right on a QM level. Something I had deal a lot before was I realized once I am in a trade I thnk capital and forget PA. I got stopped out so many times before on break Even because of that. so my advice to you: keep thinking PA although you are in a position. The market does not care about your capital, only PA matters.
